snippet.title: Tin Hearts | Meta Quest | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Tin Hearts Marches onto Meta Quest on December 3rd! 

Just in time for Christmas, Tin Hearts invites players to fall in love with a troop of mischievous tin soldiers, guiding them through an intricate series of imaginative puzzles set within a beautiful Dickensian world. Behind the toys lies a heartfelt story of family, love and the secrets of a brilliant inventor. 

Pre-Order Now: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/tin-hearts-act-1/3187602128010678/
